GREENHOUSE EFFECT

Keyword Fact

Greenhouse effect Natural warming due to absorption/re-radiation of heat by GHGs

Concept proposed by Joseph Fourier — 1820s

Without GHE Earth avg. temperature ≈ −18°C

Main GHG CO₂

Most abundant GHG Water vapour

NOT GHG Argon

Methane source Paddy fields → anaerobic condi ons

N₂O source Nitrogen fertilisers

MAJOR GREENHOUSE GASES

⇨ Natural: H₂O + CO₂ + CH₄ + N₂O + O₃ ⇨ Anthropogenic/synthetic: CFCs + HFCs + PFCs + SF₆ ⇨ CO₂ → major contributor to global warming ⇨ Water vapour → most abundant / highest natural GHG contribu on ⇨ Argon → NOT GHG ⇨ Hydrogen → NOT GHG
